chunks: He who strives does so for himself. Verily God is independent of the creatures of the world.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'He who strives does so for himself' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores that the ultimate beneficiary of Jihad is the self, as God is entirely self-sufficient (Al-Ghani) and requires no aid from His creation. It serves as a reminder that spiritual striving is an act of self-purification and accumulation of merit for the individual, rather than a service rendered to a needy deity.
